description: Asked about dinner and the ladies, and did not take a house candle.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Carried the pot, withheld a ruling on The Shrew, and left the latch where it was.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Said he had seen the afternoon bill and had not stayed.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Said the afternoon was the company's, kept Thursday's verdict as she had given it, and named no new errand.
name: William Shakespeare
